conventions.name: component-levels-are-the-three-atomic-tiers
conventions.description: AGENTS.md § Components and forms: components live under atoms/, molecules/ or organisms/. Any other directory under _components is rejected; the shape rule would simply not match it, so a stray tier would go unchecked rather than flagged. Measured at 3/3 conforming when added.

conventions.name: component-directories-are-kebab-case
conventions.description: AGENTS.md § Naming: component directories are kebab-case. The shape rule skips names it does not match, so they need an explicit rejection. Measured at 14/14 conforming when added.

conventions.name: component-directory-shape
conventions.description: AGENTS.md § Components and forms: each component is a directory whose files are named after it, so button/ holds button.tsx, button.test.tsx and index.ts. ${component} is the captured directory name, so the triple is enforced per component. Measured at 14/14 conforming when added.

conventions.name: component-barrel-reexports-component
conventions.description: The per-component index.ts exists so callers can import the component's directory; it holds re-exports and nothing else. Measured at 14/14 conforming when added.

conventions.name: schema-domain-has-barrel
conventions.description: AGENTS.md § API (oRPC): input schemas live at src/lib/schemas/{domain}/index.ts. Measured at 2/2 conforming when added.

conventions.name: hook-domain-has-barrel
conventions.description: AGENTS.md § Hooks: each hook domain has an index.ts, and callers import the domain. Measured at 1/1 conforming when added.

conventions.name: hooks-stay-client-side
conventions.description: Hooks are client-side React Query wrappers over the oRPC client. A value import of the Drizzle client or a server service would pull server code into the browser bundle; a type import is erased and stays allowed. Measured at 2/2 conforming when added.

conventions.name: routers-contain-no-drizzle-queries
conventions.description: AGENTS.md § API: a router is input schema → auth check → service call, with no Drizzle even for one-step CRUD, so crons, scripts and tests reuse the same queries without a request. Every read and write goes through src/server/services/. konsistent sees imports, not member access: scripts/lint-router-db.sh catches `context.db.query…` with no import. Measured at 1/1 conforming when added.

conventions.name: services-are-framework-agnostic
conventions.description: docs/agents/database.md § Services own every query: a service runs from a cron, a script or a test without a request. next/headers and next/server reach into the live request, the oRPC procedures carry its context, and an error tracker is the interceptor's job; a service receives what it needs as arguments. Measured at 1/1 conforming when added.

conventions.name: services-hold-no-react
conventions.description: Services are plain async functions over the database. A React or next/navigation import means UI logic leaked into the domain layer, and the service would drag it into every cron and script. Measured at 1/1 conforming when added.
